name: supernova burst water
description: Supernova-burst neutrino interactions in water, generated by sntools (SNEWS2). One dataset subcase per <model>/<ordering>: mass ordering maps to sntools' AdiabaticMSW_NMO/_IMO transformation. This config ships two self-contained analytic gamma fluxes so it validates end-to-end with no SNEWPY download; swap each model's format/flux_file for SNEWPY-<Model> for physics runs. Remove supernova.cap_events for full realistic burst sizes.
